name: Manasaputra, Angirasa
body:
ANGIRASA
CR 2

This flying childlike figure seems to be formed by a myriad motes of fiery light.

XP 600
LG Small outsider (extraplanar, lawful, good, manasaputra)
Init +1; Senses Senses darkvision 60 ft, Perception +7

DEFENSE

AC 14, touch 14, flat-footed 13 (+1 deflection, +2 soul armor, +1 size)
hp 15 (2d10+4)
Fort +2, Ref +3, Will +5; +2 vs. enchantment
Immune calling, disease, poison; Resist fire 5

OFFENSE

Speed 20 ft., fly 60 ft. (perfect)
Melee slam +3 (1d3+3)
Ranged ray of fire +3 (1d6 fire)
Psychic Magic (CL 2nd; concentration +4; Wis-based)

6 PE-analyze aura (3 PE)

Special Attacks blinding light
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 2nd; concentration +4; Wis-based)

At will–teleport (self only), preserve grace
1/day-lesser plane shift (Positive Energy Plane only)

STATISTICS

Str 13, Dex 10, Con 14, Int 14, Wis 15, Cha 13
Base Atk +2; CMB +2; CMD 15
Feats Power Attack
Skills Diplomacy +6, Fly +5, Heal +7, Knowledge (planes) +7, Knowledge (religion) +7, Perception +7, Sense Motive +7, Spellcraft +7
Languages Celestial, Common; telepathy 100 ft.
SQ formless, no breath, positive energy affinity, subjective appearance

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Blinding Light (Su)

Once every 1d4 round, an angirasa in incorporeal form can increase its light to a blinding spiritual flash. Creatures adjacent to the angirasa must succeed at a DC 13 Will save or be dazzled for 1d4 rounds. The save is Wisdom-based.

ECOLOGY

Environment any (Material Plane or Positive Energy Plane)
Organization solitary or swarm (1-100)
Treasure incidental

The weakest of manasaputra, angirasas are formed by souls still too bound to the Material Plane to fully ascend to the Positive Energy Plane. Beings of light and fire, angirasas try to elevate themselves by helping mortals observe morality and be faithful to rituals. They are attracted to heroes and sages who have difficult choices before them, and feel the need to help them make the right choice according to their ethics. Angirasas also cluster around ceremonies and sacrifices, to ensure that all is done properly.

A LG arcane spellcaster of at least 7th level with the Improved Familiar feat may select an angirasa as a familiar.
